_comment: Firebase web config. These values are NOT secrets — they identify the project, they do not authorise anything. Security comes from firestore.rules and from the authorised-domains list in the Firebase console. Google documents this explicitly. Fill these in from Firebase console → Project settings → Your apps → Web app.
_setup: See docs/SETUP-FIREBASE.md for the full walkthrough.
_moderatorUids: After your first sign-in, put your own uid here so you can moderate. Find it in Firebase console → Authentication → Users.
_sdkVersion: Copy the version from the snippet Firebase shows you when you register the web app. If sign-in silently does nothing, this is the first thing to check.
